text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had come to pray at the shrine with Yamanin Zephyr, who hasn't been in good form lately, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry you had to go out of your way for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt out of sorts, as if
a dark summer wind were clinging to my body...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooooosh)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... this feeling...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I felt a very gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind that feels as though it's embracing me...
as though it's playing alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm just surrendering myself to the wind.
Strangely enough, I feel like I've become lighter, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't entirely sure what was happening,
but perhaps the wind was offering her encouragement
in her slump...
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we pay our respects at the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr quietly pressed her hands together and finished her prayer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I only hope my feelings
can ride the wind and reach the gods.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh dear....

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooooosh)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Such a gentle breeze.
Thank you very much, it's truly encouraging."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I shall repay this kindness by stirring a fresh breeze across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Strangely enough, from that day forward, Yamanin Zephyr began to feel much better.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? The wind has died down...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...At this rate, my prayers might not reach them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the wind dying down, a disheartened
Yamanin Zephyr remained unable
to get back into top form.
